description: Home advantage for a 2DT sport is RAW POINTS -- the model is additive, there is no link to undo. Applying football's exp() to an additive 4-point parameter published a home edge of 54.6 and every schema in the tree accepted it (B5). median and lower stay within +/-30 and reject that shape. upper is wider on purpose: the per-team prior is normal(0,10) on each side, so a team with one match carries a 95% upper of ~35-45 that is the model's honest uncertainty, not a units error -- and a cap that rejects it darkens the whole cell. The exact check is tests/testthat/test-extract-2dt-home-advantage-units.R.
